Anya Petrova: PTAL — pushed changes for PR #3421. Addressed comments, split flaky test into a separate commit, and added a quick smoke script. Can we grab a canary slot tomorrow morning?
Rob Chen: Looking now, thanks. Quick Q — did you keep the API contract unchanged?
Anya Petrova: Yep, no API changes. Added a nil-payload guard and a comment only. Smoke script is at scripts/smoke_run.sh
Shay Patel: PTAL from infra side. OK with canary if CI green. Left one tiny nit inline.
Anya Petrova: Fixed the nit and force-pushed.
CI Bot: Build #3421.7 failed — unit-timeout on TestShardAllocator. Logs: ```timeout waiting for shard init```
Rob Chen: hmm, can you re-run CI? Might be transient.
Anya Petrova: Kicked CI again and bumped the test timeout a hair, pushed a new commit.
CI Bot: Build #3421.8 passed :white_check_mark:
Shay Patel: :thumbsup: one more approver needed before we schedule canary.
Kevin Morales: LGTM from me, I reviewed the flakes change and the smoke script.
MergeOps Bot: Canary slot reserved for 2026-03-19 10:00 UTC — merge ops hold requested.
Rob Chen: Great — @MergeOps Bot can you schedule the merge? I'm happy to custodian the merge if ops confirms.
MergeOps Bot: Merge custody assigned to Rob Chen. Merge will be executed after canary start and post-smoke success.
Anya Petrova: Thanks everyone — PTAL again if anything else looks off.
Rob Chen: Merging now :shipit:
